idea-plugin.name: Phantom for WebP
idea-plugin.description: Opens WebP images (lossy, lossless, with alpha) in the image editor and in thumbnails, like PNG. Decoding is done in Java by the TwelveMonkeys ImageIO WebP reader (BSD), with no native library, so it works the same on every OS. Reading only: the IDE does not save WebP files. Replaces the bundled WebP plugin; turn that one off if your Phantom still bundles it.
